g.text: D. Within-domain centered age: geometry at α = 1000
What age-prediction utility lies in site-predictive directions?
External development predictions only. Negative contrasts favor the first named model. Bars: descriptive 95% paired hierarchical bootstrap intervals.
Filled circles: all rows. Hollow diamonds: identical eligible common-support domains for absolute and centered scoring.
Centering uses evaluation ages; it is not a deployable correction. Atlases/views are not independent replications. No confirmatory or causal claim.
